acceptance: Regression test: with forced small blocks, every partition file's row groups are row_group_size except the last; the test fails without the fix.
A recorded partitioned conversion shows peak RSS not higher than before the change.
Non-partitioned Parquet output is sha256-identical to develop.
PR merged to develop with a changelog.d fragment.
context: Split out on 2026-11-25 from an adversarial review of the datagen effort (finding C2). An uncommitted test and one-line fix exist in worktree ../BenchBox.wt-fix-parquet-single-writer; reuse only those hunks.
description:
## Problem
`ParquetConverter._write_partitioned` calls `pyarrow.dataset.write_dataset(..., max_rows_per_group=row_group_size)` without `min_rows_per_group`, so each ~1 MiB CSV block becomes its own row group (observed ~1,971-row groups at 1M rows / 7 partitions) while the manifest and `parquet_data_generation_identity_hash` record 122,880. Reachable from `benchbox convert --partition` and runs with `table_format_partition_cols`.

## Change
- Pass `min_rows_per_group=opts.row_group_size` alongside `max_rows_per_group`.
- Add a regression test that forces small input blocks and asserts partition files have full row groups plus one tail.

## Decision gates
- Cached partitioned output keeps the same identity hash after this fix. Invalidation is deferred to the writer-identity bump in datagen-p1-parquet-semantic-fixes, which makes every older cache stale; state this in the PR body.

## Guardrails
- Measure peak RSS on one partitioned conversion (review probe: 12M rows / 1,000 partitions went 2,368 -> 1,578 MiB) and record it; stop if memory rises.
- No change to non-partitioned output. AGENTS.md workflow, changelog fragment, merged PR.
